plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Supervise a multi-provider fleet of AI coding workers (Codex, Antigravity, Grok Build, Cursor, Copilot, Qwen Code, Droid, Amp, Claude headless, OpenCode/local) from Claude Code: registry-driven routing (capability, cost, track record), parallel dispatch, per-provider cooldowns with cascade fallback, verification-gated acceptance, outcome ledger. NOTE: runs unattended agents (file edits + command execution, no approval prompts) in your repo — read the README warning first; use only in repos you trust.
